name: DarkSide
full_name: DarkSide / Global Argon Dark Matter Collaboration
summary: DarkSide is the liquid-argon dark-matter programme at LNGS. DarkSide-50 has produced WIMP and low-mass dark-matter results, while DarkSide-20k scales up the target. Underground argon and efficient electron-recoil rejection are central to the programme.
detection_principle: A dual-phase liquid-argon TPC measures scintillation and ionization. The fast and slow argon scintillation components discriminate nuclear from electron recoils; low-threshold analyses can use the ionization signal alone.

status.label: Multiple phases with different statuses
status.evidence: The official website describes DarkSide-20k as a next-generation facility under construction/commissioning, with operation expected in 2028, but does not date that status update. DarkSide-50 has completed data taking and continues analysis.

phases.name: DarkSide-20k
phases.description: Next-generation liquid-argon detector; its planned dates are not observations of operating status.

results.summary: The complete low-threshold DarkSide-50 dataset sets upper limits on low-mass dark-matter scattering.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
